router_git_blame.description: Read-only git blame in the session repository. No shell, helpers, arbitrary options or writes. Output is bounded to 64 KiB and 15 seconds. Paths are literal and repository-relative.

described.path: Literal repository-relative path; required for blame
described.ref: Ref or diff range, at most 200 characters; never an option

router_verify.description: Verify delegations that returned 'unverified' with a vrf_ handle. Runs the same checks as a required verification (affected tests, batched, under the verification slot and one gate deadline) and returns one verdict per handle: pass, fail (with the introduced failures and a suggested next tier) or unverifiable. Nothing is retried or escalated for you. Pass exactly one of `handles` or `pending: true` (every unverified delegation of this session).

described.handles: The vrf_ handles from the delegations' [router] footers.
described.pending: true: verify every still-unverified delegation of this session.
